notes.title: Super Rad Raygun has a new home on itch.io!
notes.content:
Indie action platformer Super Rad Raygun will be leaving Steam after August 30, 2019. Once gone from Valve's digital marketplace, it will only be available through itch.io for $5 (though will remain playable for people that purchase it). The reason for this delisting has to do with TRU FUN Entertainment, developer of the game, closing its doors. Super Rad Raygun was originally co-published by Screwattack Games and RT Games, but the rights were handed back over to TRU FUN last year when the title was put on itch.io. Since the studio will no longer be operating, it cannot leave the game on Steam.

Chris Bryant, co-founder of TRU FUN Entertainment, said, "We're extremely sad to see Super Rad Raygun leave Steam.  This game was a labor of love -- taking up our nights and weekends for over three years!  Thankfully, Super Rad Raygun can live on through itch.io."

https://www.destructoid.com/indie-action-platformer-super-rad-raygun-leaving-steam-in-august-558770.phtml

https://trufun.itch.io/super-rad-raygun

notes.title: We now have audio on Xbox One!
notes.content:
Thanks to Ethan Lee and his FNA framework, we now have audio for Super Rad Raygun on Xbox One!

We've been accepted into the ID@Xbox program, and the game itself is probably 85% done.  We still have some kinks to work out with audio, but as you can tell from the video, we're close!  Other than that, the Xbox One port is in good shape!  All of the levels are playable and in-tact.  Once we get the audio issues ironed out, we're moving onto Xbox Live integration -- this includes Achievements, Leaderboards, and Cloud-save. 

https://twitter.com/trufun202/status/980109000338526208​

In the meantime, you can still grab Super Rad Raygun on the cheap during our Easter Sale!  And, if you prefer DRM-free, hop over to itch.io:  https://trufun.itch.io/super-rad-raygun

We'll keep you guys posted on our progress -- stay tuned!

ːradraygunː

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.8 is Live (Patch Notes)
notes.content:
Hey everyone, 

You may have seen several very small updates come through over the last couple of days, with the most recent update coming this morning. Here is a list of current updates from the original build:

[list]
[*]Fixed occasional crash that would occur while loading levels.
[*]Increased the game's RAM limit to fix a bug where the game would occasionally freeze on the "Loading" screen for some players.
[*]Set the soundtrack live so that players who owned the OST were able to download the files.
[*]Removed a beta tool that allowed players to unlock levels on the world map without completing them.
[*]When mapping keyboard controls, the use of the arrow keys is now supported and will be saved properly in the user's settings.
[*]When mapping keyboard controls, the use of the number pad, shift, alt, and ctrl keys are now supported and will be saved properly in the user's settings.
[*]Fixed a bug which caused some players' games to crash if they competed in the Time Attack mode and didn't make it into the top ten. 
[*]Added fan art to Cape Canaveral
[*]Fixed a bug in Moscow where the final boss could get stuck in the wall
[*]Patched an exploit that allowed players to keep bits in Dr. Y's Lab after purchasing upgrades
[*]Fixed a sound balancing issue
[*]Corrected an invisible Wall in Gernada
[*]Fixed a bug where falling off a platform in the final boss fight didn't always kill Rad.
[/list]

Thank you all for your help in reporting these bugs. As always, be sure to use the official bug report thread to help us quickly identify and correct any issues!

[i]-Austin[/i]

notes.title: Super Rad Raygun is LIVE!
notes.content: Hey everyone, we're very, very excited to announce that Super Rad Raygun is now live for PC, Mac, and Linux! As an added bonus, we're giving away free copies of the soundtrack, featuring music from FantomenK and BubblePipe Media, to players who pick up the game before November 15th.
